messages:
alex: Alert — hosted-generation /v1/generate is seeing a surge of 5xxs and timeouts starting ~2026-03-15 03:10 UTC. Multiple customer tickets. @priya you're oncall. @sam please pull traces.

ops-bot: [ALERT] hosted-gen /v1/generate 5xx-rate=3.4% p95 latency ↑ — https://grafana.redwood/d/hosted-gen/overview

priya: Triage started. Capturing traces, sample requests, and top offending routes. Who has the customer list?

ana: CS: AcmeInc, BetaCorp, GammaLabs opened tickets. Uploading repro payloads to CS-4127 and attaching to this thread.

sam: Quick look at runtime logs shows repeated "hotset-eviction" and batcher queue timeouts. Snippet:
```
[03:11:58] runtime WARN: kv_hotset eviction: 1200 keys/sec
[03:12:00] batcher ERROR: queue_timeout for batch=0x1c2
[03:12:01] proxy ERROR: upstream 502 for req=0xABC
```

mei: I reproduced locally with long-prefix prompts (~2000+ tokens). Recent deploy f9d4 modified cache sharding and aggressively lowered per-key retention under memory pressure — when long sequences hit the hotset it thrashes and miss-rate explodes.

lucas: We should fast-revert f9d4 to verify. I'll coordinate the revert with deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: rollout revert initiated: service=hosted-gen release=f9d4 -> previous (id r-20260315-02). ETA ~6m.

priya: Sending an interim customer-facing note: "We're investigating increased 502s/timeouts; mitigation underway." Ana please post.

ana: Sent interim message and offered a 5% credit pending final RCA. Will escalate to account owners if not resolved in 1h.

sam: Canary metrics after revert: kv miss-rate fell from 72% -> 6%. 5xx rate on canary dropped to 0.4%. Strong correlation with revert.

mei: Canary long-prefix tests passed. Root cause: sharding + TTL regression causing eviction churn under long-sequence workloads.

lucas: Immediate mitigations applied:
- reverted f9d4 to prod
- temporarily increased autoscaler target by 50%
- lowered circuit-breaker threshold for long-seq requests to fail-fast

priya: Monitoring live. Posting status updates every 20 minutes until metrics stabilize.

sam: Draft postmortem bullets:
- Incident start: 03:10 UTC
- Revert confirmed: 03:18 UTC
- RCA: cache sharding + retention regression -> eviction storm -> backend queueing -> 502/timeouts
- Mitigations: revert, autoscale bump, CB tuning
- Action items assigned below

mei: Action items (owners & due dates):
- mei: add long-sequence e2e regression tests to pre-release suite and create a harness for cache-behavior tests (due 2026-03-19)
- sam: add per-shard eviction and per-key TTL histograms, alert on miss-rate > 10% (due 2026-03-17)
- lucas: update deploy gating to include canary long-seq load tests and a cache-warmup playbook (due 2026-03-16)
- ana: finalize customer comms and credit reconciliation (due 2026-03-17)
- priya: produce full postmortem and circulate to execs (due 2026-03-16)

ana: Customer update: AcmeInc requested ETA for permanent fix. BetaCorp acknowledged credit and will close ticket after final note.

lucas: I'll propose a synthetic warmup job that hits known long-prefix paths every 5m to keep hot keys warm, plus an RFC for adaptive TTL per workload and a dashboard panel for eviction heatmaps.

priya: War room closing — prod metrics returning to baseline (5xx < 0.5%, p95 latency normalizing). I will add the postmortem link and action item tracker.

sam: Postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/2026-03-15-hosted-gen-kv-eviction

mei: Long-term fix plan: adaptive retention windows, safer sharding rollout, and pre-deploy long-seq canary runs.

alex: Thanks all. Please paste the PM/exec link and confirm action-item statuses when available.
